name: uv_work_submit

ownership.argument: Submits a caller-owned 20-byte internal work prefix (worker, done, loop, queue[2]). The work callback executes in the pool; done(work,status) executes on the supplied running loop. Caller retains storage until done and may free it there. Does not initialize or alter foreign-loop handle lists.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery recorded in EVID-ASTROLINK-4155-BLE-001; Astrolink static ABI audit on 2026-10-30.

notes: Private uv__work_submit ABI from C3F4CC4. C3F4C82 locks the worker submission queue. C3F80FC-C3F812C append completion under target loop+76 mutex then signal loop+104 async. C3F7F14 drains that queue and invokes done(work,status). Unlike public uv_queue_work C3F4CF8 this internal entry does not manipulate loop active_reqs. Requires running loop and target wake fd accessible to existing firmware pool workers. Physical behavior unprobed.
